summary.target_position_range: No target position in this dossier; current about 1.19% ratio is an input for downstream portfolio modules.
summary.one_line_conclusion: 振华风光 has clear high-reliability IC logic and low debt, but 2025 revenue/profit declined, 2026Q1 turned loss, valuation is still high on PE/PS, and trend/fund-flow proxies remain weak; Watch only.

basic_info.related_theme: 高可靠集成电路 / 军工电子 / 半导体
basic_info.theme_rating: 半导体 B but divergent; military electronics not confirmed as current A/B tactical mainline
basic_info.cost_policy: Cost amount is not recorded in this dossier.

position_role.overlap_with_existing_holdings: Overlaps with military, low-altitude, satellite and semiconductor exposure; downstream portfolio module should aggregate group risk.

long_term_logic: Main business is IC products; 2025 product revenue is mostly integrated-circuit products.
High-reliability analog/IC products have long-term localization and military-electronics logic.
Low debt and strong 2025 operating cash flow provide balance-sheet buffer.
current_problems: 2025 revenue declined about 23.10% and parent net profit declined about 40.90%.
2026Q1 revenue declined about 27.45% and parent net profit turned loss.
Q1 weakness is linked to demand decline, longer product acceptance cycle and partial product price cuts.
core_assumptions: Demand for high-reliability IC products eventually stabilizes.
Product pricing pressure eases and acceptance cycle normalizes.
Semiconductor or military-electronics theme recovers enough to support valuation.
likely_failure_points: Demand weakness and product price pressure continue.
High PE/PS valuation is not supported by earnings recovery.

stock_risk_penalty.evidence: Penalty for 2025 decline, 2026Q1 loss, weak trend, negative moneyflow proxy, unconfirmed tactical mainline and still-high PE/PS valuation.

valuation.conclusion: Low PB percentile is not enough; PE/PS remain high while earnings trend is weak.

hold_conditions: Keep only as a small watch input if portfolio accepts military-electronics/semiconductor overlap.
Wait for 2026 interim report, MA20/MA60 repair and fund-flow improvement.
reduce_conditions: Portfolio continues reducing military, low-altitude, satellite or semiconductor weak overlap.
2026 interim report fails to repair revenue, profit or acceptance-cycle pressure.
Price remains below MA20/MA60 with continuing net outflow proxy.
sell_invalid_conditions: Earnings keep weakening while PE/PS stay high.
Theme remains weak and same-group concentration remains high.

notes: No direct sell advice in this dossier.
Downstream ACTION_PLAN may use this as a risk-reduction input.

data_gaps: No high-reliability analog IC peer valuation table built.
Moneyflow uses Tushare raw proxy and is not equivalent to verified institutional flow.
